message.content:
**Strict Design Audit — 390px Home Screen**

**1) Dominant canvas background:** Neutral near-white, not cream/beige. Approx **#F5F5F4 / #F4F4F3** (very light cool gray-white). Cards are pure white #FFFFFF on top of it.

**2) Doctor cards with real human face photos:** YES. Real photographic faces are visible — **2 faces** (Rajesh, General Physician, fully visible; a second doctor partially cropped on the right edge of the horizontal carousel). Hospitals correctly use initials ("CH", "QB"), not faces.

**3) Monochrome + teal secondary:** YES. Primary palette is black/white/gray (typography, stats band, nav). Teal appears only as a functional secondary — search icon, location pin, icon tiles (stethoscope, test tubes) on pale-teal tint circles, "live" badge dot. Restrained and consistent.

**4) Black stats band with white numbers:** YES. Near-black (#111/#0A0A0A) rounded band with large white numerals — 97 doctors, 13 hospitals, 72 visits booked — gray labels beneath, plus a small teal live-dot on "97". Strong visual anchor.

**5) Floating white bottom nav pill with black active circle:** YES. White rounded pill, floating with shadow, slightly overlapping hospital cards. Active "Home" = black filled circle with white icon + bold label; inactive "Bookings"/"Profile" = gray outline icons. Correct pattern.

**6) Chips with visible thin rings:** YES. fever / knee pain / skin / child / acidity chips are white with a visible thin light-gray ring (~1px #E5E5E5) and soft shadow. Consistent radius. Note: the last chip ("acidity") is cut off — acceptable for a scrollable row.

**7) Overall character:** **Clean monochrome medical app (Uber-like)** — near-white neutral canvas, black accents, black stats band, teal used sparingly. Not warm/beige.

**8) Defects:**
- **Bottom nav overlaps content:** the pill partially covers hospital card metadata ("2 doctors / 2 departments" is obscured). Needs bottom padding/scroll inset.
- **"See all" button misaligned:** vertically it floats oddly next to "Hospitals" heading; baseline alignment could be tightened.
- **Second doctor card cropped abruptly** at right edge — fine for carousel, but its price text ("₹300 v…") is clipped.
- **Stray content at bottom:** "Lab tests at home" heading peeks below the nav — section bleeding under the floating nav; layout needs bottom safe-area handling.
- **Minor:** hospital card subtitle gray-on-white contrast is on the low side but acceptable.
